messages.content: What are the primary triads in the key of C major?

function.name: music_analysis_find_common_chords
function.description: Find the most common chords in a specific genre of music. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

genre.description: The genre of music to analyze.

num_chords.description: The number of top common chords to return.

message.content:
In the key of **C major**, the primary triads—those built on the tonic (I), subdominant (IV), and dominant (V) degrees—are:

| Scale Degree | Triad Name | Notes |
|--------------|------------|-------|
| I (Tonic)    | C Major   | C – E – G |
| IV (Subdominant) | F Major | F – A – C |
| V (Dominant) | G Major   | G – B – D |

These three chords form the harmonic backbone of many pieces in C major, providing resolution (tonic), preparation (subdominant), and tension (dominant).
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What are the primary triads in the key of C major?" They want the primary triads (I, IV, V). In C major, I is C major, IV is F major, V is G major. So answer: C major, F major, G major. Probably mention they are built on root, fourth, fifth degrees. Provide explanation.
